description: This file defines an enumeration 'TransactionalStatus' representing various states of a transaction, along with extension methods for handling transaction status, such as determining if a status indicates an abort and converting statuses to user exceptions.

classes.name: TransactionalStatusExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for the TransactionalStatus enum, including logic to determine if a status indicates an abort and to convert a status to a specific exception.

methods.name: DefinitelyAborted
methods.description: Determines if the given transaction status indicates a definite abort condition.

methods.name: ConvertToUserException
methods.description: Converts a transaction status into a corresponding user exception, incorporating transaction ID and original exception.
